title: Compiler-owned enclave gateway is unavailable or violates the handoff contract
symptoms: AWF host gateway readiness fails before primary-agent startup
conditions: The compiler launches mcpg and hands AWF the private enclave endpoint and gateway identity
Only documented retryable backend_unavailable responses qualify for bounded initialize retries; other auth, protocol or tool-contract failures are terminal
Host handshake readiness does not establish guest network or workload success
rootCause: The compiler-owned backend can still be coming up, or the compiled gateway identity/tools/protocol contract can differ from AWF's expected contract. The exact bounded AWF-host phase/code is needed to distinguish these causes.

probe.expect: Inspect the projected awf-host readiness phase, code, HTTP status, attempts and checklist. Preserve not-attempted stages; a separate harness handshake or healthy broker is not AWF-host readiness.

action: Match compiler, AWF and mcpg contracts using checked-in lock metadata and current integration docs. Static entries require the documented gateway spec floor; dynamic repository admission requires mcpg v0.4.18 or newer because earlier duration decoding used nanoseconds. Preserve the bounded retry deadline and terminal failures; do not bypass the gateway or infer that a larger timeout fixes a contract mismatch.
